articles.title: Construction Simulator: Evolution - Official Demolition Feature Gameplay Overview Trailer - IGN
articles.summary: Get a deep dive into the demolition gameplay feature of Construction Simulator: Evolution in this latest trailer for the next game in the Construction Simulator game series. In this new video, make your way to an old industrial site on the US-inspired map and learn about different materials and how to tackle them with specific machinery.In Construction Simulator: Evolution, you will be able to use officially licensed machines and suitable attachments from both new and returning licensing partners. These include the SENNEBOGEN 670 E equipped with a wrecking ball, the hydraulic Combi Cutter CC 1600 U with universal jaws from Epiroc, and a handheld demolition hammer from Wacker Neuson. With demolition, Construction Simulator: Evolution expands the familiar construction site experience with an entirely new phase of work. You'll take on contracts that require you to dismantle existing structures before the site can be transformed. And demolition isn't simply about hitting a building until it disappears. In this new trailer, journey to an old industrial site in Amber Falls, a US-inspired map, where an existing complex needs to make way for something new.Construction Simulator: Evolution will be available in PC Early Access, with PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X/S to follow.

Dune Awakening launches September 22nd for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

articles.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Gunny Loadout System Explained - IGN
articles.summary: If you’ve ever felt like Call of Duty’s weapon customization requires a degree in spreadsheet management just to build a decent loadout, Modern Warfare 4 has a new solution for you. Enter Gunny, a brand-new tool designed to remove the friction of the traditional Gunsmith. Whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned veteran, Gunny allows you to simply pick a gun and a preferred playstyle—like long-range, balanced, or close-quarters—and instantly equips a tailored, usable weapon setup based on the attachments you've unlocked.In this video, we break down exactly how the Gunny system works in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. We explore how you can reroll playstyles to get completely different attachment combinations, swap out individual parts like a drum mag while keeping the overall build intact, and why it won't replace traditional full Gunsmith customization for those who still want total manual control. Gunny proves to be a surprisingly effective addition to the loadout process that gets you into multiplayer matches faster without hamstringing your options.
